lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid-like distribution of approximately 24 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in 6 vertical columns and 4 horizontal rows on the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clearly defined vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with horizontal carinae, where high-intensity blobs are positioned at the grid vertices.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three to four parallel horizontal ridges exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition (bright upper margin, dark lower shadow) extending across the flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least five remora fish (Echeneidae) swimming in the water column directly ventral to the shark's main body.
